productVision.summary: A cross-platform Progressive Web App (PWA) for managing financial assistance (loans) in Tanzanian Shillings (TZS) with mandatory Client Referral / Guarantor tracking, automatic interest calculation, strict deadline & overdue rollover enforcement, real-time PC-to-Phone synchronization outside the local network, and a one-time activation key licensing system for multi-user expansion.
coreCapabilities: All financial assistance, interest, penalties, and repayments tracked and formatted in Tanzanian Shillings (TZS)
Mandatory Referral / Guarantor Information on every client (Referral Name, Phone Number, Relationship, Location/NIDA, and Referral Trust Chain analytics)
Real-time cloud synchronization between Desktop PC and Mobile Phone over any network (Wi-Fi, 4G, 5G) with local IndexedDB offline fallback
Instant dashboard visibility of Total Principal Offered (TZS), Interest %, Expected Profit (TZS), Total Expected Collection (TZS), Realized Profit (TZS), and Overdue Loans
Automated time-bound interest & 'Or Else' overdue penalty/rollover engine (e.g., 30 days for 20% interest, plus automatic rollover or daily penalty after day 30)
Multi-tenant SaaS architecture with single-use expiring Activation Keys and Super Admin management portal

fields.description: Full name of the person who referred or guaranteed the client (e.g., Musa Juma)
Phone number of the referral (+255 7XX XXX XXX) for 1-click Call or WhatsApp escalation
How the referral knows or guarantees the borrower
Physical shop/office address, NIDA ID, or notes about the referral
Links to an existing borrower record if the referral is also an active/past client

escalationFeatures: Global search ('Ctrl+K') finds loans by either Client Name/Phone OR Referral Name/Phone
1-Click / 1-Tap 'Notify Referral via WhatsApp' (Shortcut 'R') when a referred client becomes Overdue
Automatic warning during New Loan creation if the chosen Referral has another referred client currently Overdue

variables.P: Principal Amount Offered in TZS (e.g., TZS 500,000)

overdueOrElseRules.name: Fixed Principal Cycle Rollover (Default)
overdueOrElseRules.description: When unpaid after Due Date + Grace Period, adds (P * r) for each elapsed cycle of D days.
overdueOrElseRules.example: Loan of TZS 500,000 @ 20% for 30 days (TZS 600,000 due). On Day 31, Cycle 2 starts and adds +TZS 100,000. New Total Expected = TZS 700,000.

overdueOrElseRules.name: Compound Unpaid Balance Rollover
overdueOrElseRules.description: When unpaid after Due Date + Grace Period, applies r% on the entire unpaid balance (Principal + unpaid Interest).
overdueOrElseRules.example: Loan of TZS 500,000 @ 20% for 30 days (TZS 600,000 due). On Day 31, adds 20% of TZS 600,000 (+TZS 120,000). New Total Expected = TZS 720,000.

overdueOrElseRules.name: Daily Late Percentage Fee
overdueOrElseRules.description: Adds a daily percentage fee for every day overdue past Due Date + Grace Period.
overdueOrElseRules.example: Loan of TZS 500,000 with 1% daily late fee. 5 days overdue adds +TZS 25,000. New Total Expected = TZS 625,000.

overdueOrElseRules.name: Manual Alert & Custom TZS Penalty
overdueOrElseRules.description: Highlights loan in red as OVERDUE on PC & Phone and allows lender to apply a custom TZS penalty or extend due date with 1 click.
overdueOrElseRules.example: Lender clicks '+ Apply Penalty' or '+ Extend 7 Days' from the Loan Detail drawer.

repaymentAllocationOrder: 1. Accrued Overdue Penalties / Rollover Fees in TZS (F_penalty)
2. Expected Base Interest in TZS (I_base -> moves to Realized Profit)
3. Principal Offered in TZS (P -> returns to Available Capital Pool)

activationKeyEngine.keyFormat: NAS-YYYY-XXXX-XXXX (16 alphanumeric uppercase characters formatted with hyphens)
atomicRedemptionFlow: 1. User enters Activation Key on Sign-Up screen
2. System checks activation_keys table: key exists, status == 'UNUSED', and (claim_expires_at IS NULL OR claim_expires_at > NOW())
3. User submits registration details (Business Name, Phone/Email, Password, Default Currency = TZS)
4. PostgreSQL transactional RPC creates auth user + profile, and updates activation_keys SET status = 'USED', used_by = new_user_id, used_at = NOW()
5. Key is permanently burned; any subsequent attempt to use the same key returns HTTP 409 'Activation key has already been used and expired.'

screensAndInteractions.title: Login & Activation Key Onboarding (TZS Workspace)
screensAndInteractions.desktopLayout: Centered split-tab card (520px width) on dark slate-navy canvas with live sync indicator in top bar.
screensAndInteractions.mobileLayout: Full-screen vertical card with sticky bottom submit button and native paste button for activation key.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'Alt+2' or click '[Activate New Account]' tab
interactions.systemResponse: Reveals Step 1 (Activation Key Input) and auto-focuses the key field.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Type or press 'Ctrl+V' to paste 16-char key (e.g., NAS-2026-8F4K-99XM)
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap '[Paste Key]' chip or type on uppercase alphanumeric keyboard
interactions.systemResponse: Auto-inserts hyphens every 4 chars, verifies key status against cloud DB in <150ms, and shows green 'Verified Single-Use Key' badge.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'Tab' through Business Name, Phone (+255...), Password -> Press 'Enter'
interactions.mobileTouch: Fill fields using mobile 'Next' key -> Tap '[Activate & Launch TZS Workspace]'
interactions.systemResponse: Burns activation key atomically, initializes isolated TZS workspace, and redirects to Executive Dashboard.

screensAndInteractions.title: Executive Dashboard in TZS (Desktop & Mobile)
screensAndInteractions.desktopLayout: Left navigation sidebar (240px) + Top Command Bar + 4 TZS KPI Summary Cards (Principal Offered: TZS 12,500,000, Expected Profit: +TZS 2,500,000, Total Expected Collection: TZS 15,000,000, Overdue Alert: TZS 1,800,000) + Active Loans & Referrals Table.
screensAndInteractions.mobileLayout: Top status header + Hero Expected Collection Card (TZS 15,000,000) + 2x2 KPI Grid + Filter Chips + Swipeable Loan Cards showing Client & Referral + Floating '+' Button + Bottom Nav Bar.

interactions.step: Global Search by Client or Referral
interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'Ctrl+K' or '/' -> type Client or Referral name/phone
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap Search icon in top bar -> type Client or Referral name/phone
interactions.systemResponse: Instantly filters borrowers and loans by either the borrower's details or their Referral/Guarantor's details.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'N' or click '[+ New Loan]' button
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap floating emerald '(+)' button at bottom-right
interactions.systemResponse: Opens Screen 3 (New Financial Assistance + Mandatory Referral Modal / Bottom Sheet).

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'O' or click red 'OVERDUE' KPI card
interactions.systemResponse: Filters list to loans past their due date, sorted by urgency and TZS rollover amount.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'J'/'K' to select loan -> 'Enter' for details, 'P' to record payment, 'W' to message Client, or 'R' to contact Referral
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap loan card for details, Swipe Right to record payment, Tap '[Client 💬]' or Tap '[Ref 📞]'
interactions.systemResponse: Opens Loan Detail Drawer, Repayment dialog, or pre-filled WhatsApp/Call to Client or Referral.

screensAndInteractions.title: New Financial Assistance (Client + Referral Info & Live TZS Calculator)
screensAndInteractions.desktopLayout: 2-column modal dialog: Left column for (1) Client Details, (2) Mandatory Referral/Guarantor Details, (3) Principal in TZS, Rate %, Duration, and Overdue Rule; Right column for Live TZS Earnings & Referral Summary Card.
screensAndInteractions.mobileLayout: Slide-up bottom sheet with Client & Referral inputs, Quick Preset pills ('7d @ 10%', '14d @ 15%', '30d @ 20%'), decimal keypad inputs, and sticky live TZS preview banner.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Type Client Name & Phone (+255...) or select existing client from dropdown
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap Client input -> pick existing client chip or enter new name & phone
interactions.systemResponse: If existing client is selected, auto-fills their saved Referral Information and displays their repayment trust score.

interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Press 'Tab' -> Enter Referral Full Name, Referral Phone (+255...), Relationship (e.g., Business Partner), and Location/NIDA note
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap Referral fields (or tap '[Pick Existing Client]' as Referee)
interactions.systemResponse: Validates referral fields are complete and checks if this referral has any other referred clients currently Overdue.

interactions.mobileTouch: Tap Principal (TZS) field -> numeric keypad opens -> tap '500000'
interactions.systemResponse: Auto-formats as 'TZS 500,000' and live preview immediately computes Expected Interest (+TZS 100,000) and Total Return (TZS 600,000).

interactions.step: Set Rate %, Duration Days & Overdue Rule
interactions.mobileTouch: Tap preset pill '[30d @ 20%]' and tap Overdue Rule card
interactions.systemResponse: Displays Due Date and exact Day 31+ overdue projection in TZS (e.g., 'If unpaid after 30 days: becomes TZS 700,000').
Saves client, referral, and loan to DB, updates TZS dashboard KPIs, syncs across PC & Phone, and offers 1-click Receipt sharing.

screensAndInteractions.title: Loan Detail, Overdue 'Or Else' Rollover, Referral Escalation & Repayment Drawer
screensAndInteractions.desktopLayout: Slide-over right drawer (580px) showing Overdue Banner, Client & Referral Contact Card, TZS Breakdown Cards, Mobile Money / Cash Repayment form, and Audit Timeline.
screensAndInteractions.mobileLayout: Full-screen detail view with 1-tap Client & Referral Call/WhatsApp buttons and sticky bottom '[Record TZS Payment]' bar.

interactions.mobileTouch: Tap '[Full Balance (TZS 500,000)]' chip then tap '[Record Payment]'
interactions.systemResponse: Fills exact remaining TZS balance, marks loan as PAID, and transfers interest to Realized Profit (TZS).

interactions.step: Partial Repayment via Mobile Money / Cash
interactions.desktopKeyOrClick: Type partial TZS amount -> Select M-Pesa / Tigo Pesa / Airtel Money / Cash -> Press 'Enter'
interactions.mobileTouch: Enter partial TZS amount -> Select payment method -> Tap '[Record Payment]'
interactions.systemResponse: Deducts payment from remaining TZS balance, updates progress bar, and logs transaction reference in audit history.

interactions.step: Notify Referral / Guarantor on Overdue Loan
interactions.systemResponse: Opens WhatsApp or Phone Dialer to the Referral's phone number with loan & overdue details.

screensAndInteractions.title: Client & Referral Directory + Credit Risk Profile
screensAndInteractions.desktopLayout: Searchable data table with columns: Client Name & Phone, Referred By (Name, Phone, Relation), Active Loan (TZS), Lifetime Profit Earned (TZS), and Trust Score.
screensAndInteractions.mobileLayout: Contact cards displaying Client & Referral info with 1-tap Call, WhatsApp, and Trust Score badge.

interactions.systemResponse: Shows complete TZS borrowing history, guarantor/referral contact card, and any other clients referred by the same person.

screensAndInteractions.title: Super Admin Activation Key Generator & User Manager
screensAndInteractions.desktopLayout: Admin console with Key Generator form at top and filterable Keys & Active Tenants table below.
screensAndInteractions.mobileLayout: Admin tab with 1-tap '[Generate Key]' card and shareable key list.

interactions.mobileTouch: Tap Admin Key icon -> Tap '[Generate Key]'
interactions.systemResponse: Generates unique key 'NAS-2026-XXXX-XXXX' with status UNUSED.

interactions.step: Copy / Share Key with New User
interactions.systemResponse: Copies key + invite instructions so the recipient can create their TZS lender account before the key expires.

implementationBlueprintPhases.name: Project Scaffolding & PWA Setup
deliverables: Next.js TypeScript + Tailwind CSS project initialized in workspace
PWA manifest.json, icons, and offline service worker configured for PC & Mobile installation
Responsive layout shell (Desktop Sidebar + Mobile Bottom Navigation)

implementationBlueprintPhases.name: TZS Financial Engine & Client Referral Model
deliverables: Pure TypeScript financial module (src/lib/finance-engine.ts) with TZS currency formatting
Mandatory Client Referral / Guarantor validation and referral-chain risk badges
Support for Principal (TZS), Interest %, Duration Days, Due Date, and all 4 Overdue 'Or Else' modes

implementationBlueprintPhases.name: Multi-User Auth & One-Time Activation Key System
deliverables: Database schema & Row-Level Security (RLS) for strict per-user isolation
Sign-Up with Activation Key verification & atomic key burn (UNUSED -> USED)
Super Admin Key Generator & User Licensing management screen

implementationBlueprintPhases.name: Executive TZS Dashboard, Loan + Referral Modal & Repayment Drawer
deliverables: Executive Dashboard with live TZS KPI cards (Offered, Interest %, Expected Profit, Overdue)
New Financial Assistance modal/sheet with Client + Mandatory Referral fields and live TZS calculator
Loan Detail & Repayment drawer with Mobile Money methods (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money, HaloPesa, Cash), 1-click Full Balance settlement, and Client/Referral WhatsApp reminders

implementationBlueprintPhases.name: Cross-Network Cloud Sync, Offline Queue & Keyboard Shortcuts
deliverables: Real-time sync via Supabase / Cloud API + local IndexedDB persistence
Global desktop keyboard shortcuts (N, P, R, W, D, L, B, K, O, Ctrl+K, Esc) and mobile touch gestures
Shareable TZS PDF/PNG Receipt generator showing Client, Referral, and Loan breakdown
